limitations: Restored the public radii and reduced each one by the minimum feasible common amount on the 1e-18 grid: 260409/500000000000000000. The witness is exactly feasible by Fraction arithmetic; the immediately smaller grid value fails at least one constraint.

reproduction_method.algorithm: Exact Fraction monotone binary search for the smallest common radius decrement on the 1e-18 grid; feasibility checks all four walls and all n(n-1)/2 pair distances.
